posts.title: Fonts for TV
posts.description: Typography plays a defining role in a TV show's identity. It can evoke a particular era, establish a mood or give us a hint of what's to come – sometimes before we've watched a single scene. posts.title: How to commission a custom typeface
posts.description: A custom typeface gives your brand its own distinctive voice, consistent typography and freedom from recurring licence fees. If you’re considering a custom typeface, often as part of a wider branding project, two of the biggest questions are: How much does it cost? How long does it take? posts.title: Reel: Font Story
posts.description: Reel: Bold Headlines Without the Shouting Bold condensed headlines are everywhere: film titles, posters, book covers, sports graphics, tabloid front pages.
